# Inline

Lays out children horizontally, vertically centered by default. Use it for toolbars, button groups and
"icon + text" combinations.

**Category**: Primitives · **Common uses**: Buttons, tags, icons and text side by side; with a Spacer, pushing the rest to the right

## Import

```ts
import { Inline } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Arranges children in a row, vertically centered, with spacing step 2 by default.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Inline>
      <Icon name="folder" />
      <Text>Shared documents</Text>
      <Pill tone="success">Synced</Pill>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Title row with both ends aligned

Spacer pushes the action button to the right.

```tsx
export function WithSpacer() {
  return (
    <Inline>
      <Text weight="semibold">Members</Text>
      <Text tone="tertiary" size="sm" numeric>
        12
      </Text>
      <Spacer />
      <Button size="small">Add</Button>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

### Wrapping tag group

Wraps when there is not enough space.

```tsx
export function Wrapping() {
  return (
    <Inline wrap gap={1}>
      {['Design', 'Development', 'Testing', 'Docs', 'Operations', 'Marketing', 'Support'].map(
        (t) => (
          <Pill key={t}>{t}</Pill>
        ),
      )}
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Space between children, as a spacing step. | `2` | No |
| `padding` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Padding on all sides, as a spacing step; no padding when omitted. | — | No |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end' \| 'stretch' \| 'baseline'` | Vertical alignment of the children. | `'center'` | No |
| `justify` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end' \| 'between'` | Horizontal distribution of the children; `between` pushes the first and last children to the two ends. | `'start'` | No |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | Wraps onto new lines when there is not enough space (groups of tags or buttons). | — | No |
| `grow` | `boolean` | Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline. | — | No |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'section' \| 'header' \| 'footer' \| 'nav' \| 'aside' \| 'main' \| 'ul' \| 'ol' \| 'li'` | HTML element to render. | `'div'` | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
